name: Hogent
overview:
The Haute École de Belgique is located in Ghent (Flanders)Founded in 1995 following the merger of fifteen non-university higher education establishments, it welcomes nearly 14,000 students.

HoGent has 7 campuses in Ghent and one in Aalst.

To find out more on travel advice issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Belgium, click here.
administrative:
Application dossier

Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


Visa

For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).

For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.

Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


Insurance

For European students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe.

To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For non-European students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.

Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html


Prepare your arrival:

  • https://www.hogent.be/en/future-student/practical-guide/coming-to-ghent/ (airport)
  • https://www.hogent.be/sites/hogent/assets/File/arrivalguide.pdf (A reading guide for the campus and everyday life)

courses:
Number of local credits to be earned per year: 60; i.e. 30 per semester.

It is recommended that you have a B2 level in English (no test required).

Semester 1 begins in mid-September until the end of January of the following year and then from February to the end of June for the second semester.

You will follow courses in English within the 'Faculty of Business and Information Management'.

You must validate 30 ECTS credits per semester, i.e. 60 over the year.

You can find the list of courses here.

Please note, you must choose courses related to your studies! You will not be able to choose the 6-credit "Project" module.

We remind you that attendance is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.

The course list is given to you as a reference. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.

EIP: Any tech4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
cost:
Annual travelcard for transport: 150€ (student price), you can also rent a bicycle for 80€ per year

Student restaurant (breakfast/lunch): 130€ / per month

Student room: 380€ euros / month

Procedures for the residence permit once on site: 13€ for a French student
